title: "Broad annotation and composition review"
output: html_notebook

These excerpts retain the marker-review, identity-renaming, plotting, and
subsetting code from my analysis notebook. The original biological labels,
marker panels, sample identities, numerical outputs, and conclusions have been
removed. There are no bundled data or rendered research figures.

The edited excerpts have not been rerun because the inputs are private. Code
chunks are disabled for knitting; run them locally only after supplying the
required inputs. This is an excerpt of an analysis workflow, not a complete
reproduction of the underlying study.

```{r setup, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE)
```

## Read the preprocessed object

The input object should have completed QC, doublet review, normalization, PCA,
clustering, and UMAP. It must contain `seurat_clusters` and `Samples` metadata,
and an `SCT` assay with scaled expression for the heatmap. If it contains multiple
SCT models, prepare the object for marker testing before using this excerpt.

```{r libraries-and-object}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(sctransform)

set.seed(1234)
input_root <- "data/private"
output_root <- "outputs/private"
dir.create(output_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

colors <- c('#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#279e68', '#d62728', '#aa40fc', '#8c564b',
            '#e377c2', '#b5bd61', '#17becf', '#aec7e8', '#ffbb78', '#98df8a',
            '#ff9896', '#c5b0d5', '#c49c94', '#f7b6d2', '#dbdb8d', '#9edae5',
            '#ad494a', '#8c6d31', '#FF34FF', '#763568', '#63FFAC', '#B79762',
            '#004D43', '#002dff', '#997D87', '#5A0007', '#809693', '#6A3A4C',
            '#1B4400', '#4FC601', '#3B5DFF', '#4A3B53', '#FF2F80', '#61615A',
            '#BA0900', '#6B7900', '#00C2A0', '#FFAA92', '#FF90C9', '#B903AA',
            '#D16100', '#DDEFFF', '#000035', '#7B4F4B', '#A1C299', '#300018',
            '#0AA6D8', '#013349', '#00846F', '#372101', '#FFB500', '#C2FFED',
            '#A079BF', '#CC0744', 'yellow', 'green', 'magenta', 'red')

analysis_obj <- readRDS(file.path(input_root, "preprocessed_object.rds"))
stopifnot(all(c("seurat_clusters", "Samples") %in% names(analysis_obj@meta.data)))
DefaultAssay(analysis_obj) <- "SCT"
Idents(analysis_obj) <- "seurat_clusters"
```

## Rank and inspect cluster markers

The marker thresholds and top-gene selection below are retained from my
notebook. They should be reviewed for the data being analysed. These are
exploratory comparisons between clusters, not replicate-level tests of an
experimental condition.

```{r cluster-markers}
object.markers <- FindAllMarkers(analysis_obj, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
write.table(object.markers, file.path(output_root, "cluster_markers.tsv"),
             quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
object.markers <- read.csv(file.path(output_root, "cluster_markers.tsv"), sep = "\t")

object.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 20, wt = avg_log2FC) -> top20

pdf(file.path(output_root, "cluster_marker_heatmap.pdf"), width = 15, height = 25)
DoHeatmap(analysis_obj, features = top20$gene)
dev.off()
```

The marker table and heatmap remain private outputs. `top_n` is retained from
the original code; tied values may return more than twenty genes per cluster.
Check that the selected genes are present in the assay's scaled expression.

## Apply reviewed broad annotations

The original annotation vector is replaced with a private mapping file containing
`cluster` and `broad_label` columns. No labels or cluster-to-label assignments are
distributed. Labels must be reviewed against expression and other evidence;
renaming a cluster does not itself validate its identity.

```{r apply-annotations}
Idents(analysis_obj) <- "seurat_clusters"
annotation <- read.csv(file.path(input_root, "reviewed_annotation.csv"),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character")
stopifnot(all(c("cluster", "broad_label") %in% names(annotation)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(annotation$cluster), !anyNA(annotation$broad_label))
stopifnot(setequal(annotation$cluster, levels(analysis_obj)))

# Preserve the source notebook's named-vector / RenameIdents sequence.
broad.cluster.ids <- annotation$broad_label[match(levels(analysis_obj), annotation$cluster)]
names(broad.cluster.ids) <- levels(analysis_obj)
analysis_obj <- RenameIdents(analysis_obj, broad.cluster.ids)
analysis_obj$broadtype <- Idents(analysis_obj)

pdf(file.path(output_root, "broad_annotation_umap.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
DimPlot(analysis_obj, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap", cols = colors, pt.size = 0.2)
dev.off()
```

## Inspect a privately supplied feature panel

The feature list is one gene identifier per line in a local text file. It replaces
the project-specific panel; no substitute biological panel has been invented.

```{r feature-review}
review_features <- readLines(file.path(input_root, "review_features.txt"))
stopifnot(length(review_features) > 0, all(review_features %in% rownames(analysis_obj)))
pdf(file.path(output_root, "feature_review_violin.pdf"), height = 15, width = 20)
VlnPlot(analysis_obj, features = review_features, cols = colors,
        group.by = "Samples", pt.size = 0)
dev.off()
```

## Compare within-sample composition

These are descriptive proportions among the retained cells. They do not, by
themselves, establish differences between experimental conditions or correct for
capture, filtering, and annotation effects.

```{r composition-summary}
DF <- analysis_obj@meta.data
DF <- DF %>% group_by(Samples, broadtype) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(C = sum(Count)) %>%
  mutate(percent = Count / C * 100)

pdf(file.path(output_root, "broad_annotation_composition.pdf"), width = 14, height = 10)
ggplot(DF, aes(x = Samples, y = percent, fill = broadtype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 25),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
dev.off()

Cellratio <- prop.table(table(analysis_obj$broadtype, analysis_obj$Samples), margin = 2)
Cellratio <- as.data.frame(Cellratio)

pdf(file.path(output_root, "composition_by_annotation.pdf"), width = 15, height = 12)
ggplot(Cellratio, aes(x = Var2, y = Freq)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', fill = "forest green") +
  facet_wrap(~Var1, ncol = 5, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0.8))
dev.off()
```

## Retain a reviewed subset

The original lists of biological groups are not included. Supply selected labels
locally, one per line, to use the same identity-based subsetting pattern.

```{r subset-and-save}
Idents(analysis_obj) <- "broadtype"
selected_groups <- readLines(file.path(input_root, "subset_labels.txt"))
stopifnot(length(selected_groups) > 0, all(selected_groups %in% levels(analysis_obj)))
selected_obj <- subset(analysis_obj, idents = selected_groups)
saveRDS(selected_obj, file = file.path(output_root, "selected_subset.rds"))
saveRDS(analysis_obj, file = file.path(output_root, "annotated_object.rds"))
capture.output(sessionInfo(), file = file.path(output_root, "sessionInfo.txt"))
```
